Koḍ. monia·ndï id.; ninna·ndï yesterday (see 3758). Te. nē̃ḍu today. Nk. (Ch.) nān ( obl. nāṭ- ) day. Go. (A. Y. Tr. Ph. D. Mu. M. Ko.) nēnḍ (Tr. Ph. gen. nēṭā ), (G. Ma. Pe. nēnjeŋ, nēci bār today; nēcaŋ from today; nānj day. Manḍ. nēnj (e) today. Kui nēnju id.; ro-nisi, (K.) ro-nese one day; ri-nisi , (K.) ri-nese two days. Kuwi (Su.) ro nēcu one day; (S.) nācu day; (F.) ninjū , (S. Su. Isr.) nīnju , (P.) nēnju today. DED(S, N) 2381.

Ma.) iyēnḍ , (Pat.) iyode (i.e. iyoḍe ) this year ( Voc. 179); (Tr.) hēnḍ the year before last ( Voc. 3589); (Mu.) hayēnḍ id. ( Voc. 3523); (Ko.) ēnḍ , (Pat.) yēḍa year ( Voc. 379); (Koya Su.) ēṇḍ id. Konḍa ēṇḍad id.; iyoṇḍ this year; (BB) ōnḍkaṛa, ōṭkaṛa rainy season. Pe. iyonḍiŋ this year; ṛāṭihiŋ last year. Isr.) īyona this year; (S.) rānḍu, (Ṭ.) ṛānḍu , (Isr.) ṛāṇḍu last year; (Su. Isr.) vāṇona next year. DED(S, N) 4230.
